sections.title: Submitting to Kabita Live
paragraphs: We welcome poetry in Odia, Hindi and English throughout the year. Send one poem per entry, with the requested author details. Simultaneous submissions and previously published poems are welcome with disclosure. Notify us of acceptance elsewhere or any rights conflict; credit any original poet, translator and prior publication. Monthly submissions and Toshali Anthology entries are handled separately.

Submissions are free. We currently do not pay contributors. Submitting does not guarantee selection or publication. Keep your own copy. Line and stanza breaks are preserved; fonts, bold and italics are not retained. Use the notes field for special formatting.

sections.title: Editorial selection and communication
paragraphs: Human editors assess literary merit, originality, care with language and fit for an edition. New and established writers are welcome. Social following, photographs and permission to translate are not selection requirements. Editors disclose relevant personal or financial conflicts and pass affected decisions to another editor.

A receipt confirms that an entry was received, not accepted. Selection alone does not trigger an email. Editors may keep a poem for a later issue. Rejection messages are reviewed by an editor. After publication, the author receives the edition month and year and live poem link. We do not promise a fixed response or publication deadline. An on-screen reference confirms receipt even if email is delayed or limited by anti-abuse safeguards.

sections.title: Authorship and originality
paragraphs: The poem must be the author’s own work, with quotations, sources, prior publication and any translator accurately identified. Do not submit another person’s work as your own. You must have the authority to submit the text and any accompanying images. Literary disagreement or an unfamiliar style is not evidence of misconduct.

sections.title: AI assistance and human authorship
paragraphs: Spelling, punctuation, grammar checks, dictation, transcription and transliteration are permitted when they preserve the poet’s wording and meaning. Disclosed research, brainstorming or critique may assist a poet who writes the expressive language themselves.

We do not accept AI-generated poems or generated poetic lines or stanzas, or poems substantially rewritten by AI into their final expressive form. Substantial means replacing distinctive language, imagery or voice; it is not a percentage of corrected words. Light editing of generated verse does not make it human-authored.

Describe relevant assistance honestly. Editors seek clarification before an adverse authorship finding. Drafts may help but are not mandatory proof; style or detector scores alone do not establish AI use. An honest declaration does not automatically ban an author. A second human review may be requested. The same protection of the poet’s voice applies to our editorial changes.

Kabita Live may use human-directed, reviewed assistance for artwork, authorised translation preparation and editorial production, as explained in How we work. These practices do not make the journal AI-free or transfer authorship of a submitted poem.

sections.title: Translation permission
paragraphs: Permission to prepare translations is optional, specific to the poem and selected languages, and does not affect consideration of the original. It does not automatically authorise publication. Translation assistance is declared separately from assistance with the original.

Before publishing a translation, we require appropriate rights-holder permission, source and translator credits, competent human language review and approval of the final proof. If the poet cannot read the target language, a qualified reviewer must assess fidelity. Silence is not approval.

sections.title: Rights and publication
paragraphs: Copyright remains with the author and other rightful creators. Permission for a selected work is non-exclusive and limited to its agreed Kabita Live publication and continuing online archive; it is not a transfer of ownership. Any further anthology, translation or other reuse needs the relevant permission. Readers should share the poem’s link and credit rather than reproduce the whole work without permission.

We preserve the submitted text. Changes affecting wording, meaning or deliberate formatting must be agreed with the author before publication. Corrections and permissions are recorded against the relevant version.

sections.title: Author profiles and photographs
paragraphs: An existing profile is reused after editors confirm the author match. A returning-author declaration does not itself verify identity. New biographies, social links and replacement portraits are proposals for review, not automatic changes to an established profile.

Only approved publication names, biographies, portraits and public links appear on author pages. Email addresses, private notes and assistance declarations remain private. Photo publication and artistic portrait treatment have separate permissions. Declining either does not prevent submission.

sections.title: Accompanying artwork
paragraphs: Artwork is optional. Identify its creator and confirm permission to submit and publish it. Tell us about any usage restrictions. Uploading a file alone is not permission for unrelated reuse. Editors may choose another illustration; material alterations need appropriate permission.

sections.title: Submission privacy and retention
paragraphs: We collect the poem, author and contact information, optional uploads, declarations, permissions and editorial history to review submissions, prepare approved publication and communicate with contributors. These records are private to authorised editorial and service operations until approved information is published.

Our default is indefinite private retention, including entries not selected. Withdrawal from consideration is separate from deletion. Contact the editorial address below for access, correction, consent withdrawal or deletion requests; we will assess the request and explain any continuing retention. Submission is not permission to train models or to upload unpublished poems to external detection services without appropriate permission.

Reader statistics and security services are explained in Privacy & statistics on this page. Optional Google Analytics remains consent-based. Submission details and private declarations are not public reader statistics.

sections.title: Corrections, withdrawal and review
paragraphs: To withdraw an unpublished poem, report an error or raise a rights concern, email the editors with its title and reference or page link. Do not submit a replacement as a new entry without explaining the connection. We review requests before changing publication records.

Material published corrections will be identified; we preserve an internal revision history. Removal requests are considered individually. If an authorship or rights decision seems mistaken, request a second human review with the relevant explanation.

sections.title: Reader comments and respectful participation
paragraphs: Comments are moderated before appearing publicly. We welcome respectful criticism and literary disagreement. Spam, harassment, threats, impersonation, personal contact details and material that infringes others’ rights may be withheld or removed. Views expressed by contributors and readers are their own.

sections.title: Contact and policy changes
paragraphs: Write to kabitaliveweb@gmail.com for monthly submissions, corrections, privacy questions or review requests. Include the submission reference or page link where available. Policy changes are dated; new declarations apply prospectively. Missing declarations in older records mean “not recorded”, not “no AI used”.
